parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale accurately addresses all four error targets. Sentence 1 is adjusted to avoid overstating the comment as a specific suggestion, sentence 3 correctly identifies the action (explaining differences) as explicit but lacking execution details, sentence 4 drops the unsupported inference of 'clear direction,' and sentence 5 reframes the conclusion to the appropriate rubric band without stating a numeric score or gold label. Unrelated reasoning is preserved, no evidence is invented, and the rationale can be cleanly inserted into the rescoring prompt.
